historical_protection.result: No changes to these historical files

resolved_findings.problem: A corrupt body shared by multiple Records was cached before validation; only the first Record became unavailable and later Records could be exported.
resolved_findings.resolution: Populate the snapshot cache only after validating the body bytes.

resolved_findings.problem: Discovery foreign-key locking acquired Run before Source and deadlocked against concurrent Source-to-Run item writers; a 100-link response lost discoveries.
resolved_findings.resolution: Lock Source then Run before inserting scheduler discovery evidence, and reject obsolete attempts before insertion.

resolved_findings.problem: Raw-resource Document rows for APIs could become legacy detail seeds or trigger empty-record Recheck, either misrouting the parent API or aborting the scheduler transaction.
resolved_findings.resolution: Legacy Recheck seeds and due cursors require an existing legacy seal_result; business Records separately provide frozen parent or detail requests.

resolved_findings.problem: Replacing attachment content title with parent anchor text caused direct attachment Recheck to invent a business revision when the parent was absent.
resolved_findings.resolution: Keep attachment title located in attachment bytes; retain parent input evidence separately and dispatch detail Recheck by actual representation.

resolved_findings.problem: Late callbacks could append frozen Run inputs or terminal errors; obsolete HTTP 429 observations could change current Source cooldown.
resolved_findings.resolution: Input and close writes require an active attempt status; cooldown uses the same Source-to-Run lock order and full fencing as business writes.

resolved_findings.problem: Legacy Recipes emitted bare parse diagnostics without input IDs, leaving the originating Discovery event marked parsed despite an explicit extraction error.
resolved_findings.resolution: The spider output middleware attaches the current archived response IDs to missing diagnostic references while preserving explicit references and diagnostic codes.

reviewed_invariants: Current Record pointers advance only in a complete fenced completion transaction; conflicting keys retain immutable candidates and are excluded from accepted outputs.
The same input and Binding cannot silently produce different normalized Record data in a later Run.
List reordering changes HTTP evidence without creating business versions; one changed Record independently revises.
A changed Binding is processing attribution, not proof of source content change.
Unobserved Records stay unknown and are never inferred deleted.
Discovery records actual native Scrapy fingerprints and ancestry before scheduler deduplication; it does not schedule requests independently.
Runtime manifests are immutable content-addressed artifacts attached to existing Runs, not a second operational state ledger.
All outputs retain quality_status=not_evaluated; no Evaluation, Management governance or Agent execution was introduced.

limits: Synthetic fixtures verify Runtime behavior and failure boundaries, not source completeness or business accuracy.
DNS rebinding, malicious Recipe sandboxing, production scale and power-loss durability remain outside the established Runtime test guarantees.
The 111-source rollout is a subsequent milestone; candidate sample adapters remain unaccepted until real business inputs and two-round results are available.
